expected.summary: This is a lab report from City Diagnostics Laboratory dated 14 March 2025, requested by Dr. A. Mehta. It lists the results of a Complete Blood Count done on a blood sample. The report shows haemoglobin, white blood cell count and platelet count, as well as an HbA1c result, each with the laboratory's reference range.

termsExplained.definition: A Complete Blood Count is a common blood test that measures the different types of cells in the blood.
HbA1c is a blood test that reflects average blood sugar levels over roughly the past two to three months.
WBC stands for white blood cells, the cells of the immune system found in the blood.
